correctness.rationale: The inspected primary proof yields a normalized pointwise bound |grad_L u| <= C A |x|^{-alpha} for anchored harmonic functions. The distribution of |x|^{-alpha} has exact exponent 1/alpha, so the weak endpoint follows directly and scale-invariantly. The explicit harmonic profile sgn(x)|x|^(1-2alpha) has matching flux and finite Friedrichs energy, and its exact gradient distribution proves both strong-endpoint failure and sharpness against all larger weak exponents.
